description: Use an isolated worktree and TDD to reproduce GitHub #141, investigate current LayoutIndex behavior, fix boundary construction, validate, and obtain a cold-agent review before pushing a pedagogical PR.

comments.text: Reproduced reported a22a1516 LayoutIndex via standalone ExUnit: OTP 29.0.5 raises :not_orddict; OTP 28.3 emits 3 entries with duplicate 0xFF end key. Current develop removed bulk build_index in 5d65c846 (#194) in favor of per-entry insert; OTP29 CI already present. Scope is actual-recovery-layout regression tests (both fetch orders, distinct refs, exact tree and boundary routing) and tested-toolchain docs; no obsolete builder patch or release backport.

Validation on OTP29.0.5/Elixir1.20.3: targeted 7/7; full suite 3025 passed, 2 distributed excluded; format, test compile warnings-as-errors, strict Credo, Dialyzer (0 errors), mix deps.audit passed. Cold independent review bedrock-99z found no actionable issues. Mint Hex advisory/audit discrepancy separately tracked bedrock-783. Current PR adds tests/docs only; historical repro fails without patch exactly as issue reports.

Rebased unchanged two-file diff onto latest develop abc99faa (#229/#230). Refreshed lock-resolved dependencies; final full OTP29 suite passes 3066 tests with 2 excluded. Commit cdc134df. Final mix quality rerun in progress.

Published PR https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/231 after cold review. Final rebase compile warnings-as-errors and mix quality passed; full suite 3066 passed, 2 distributed excluded. Commit cdc134df pushed.

title: gh-141: Reproduce and fix duplicate layout boundaries
